{{Quote|The scout has not checked in from the village. He's long overdue.|The pirate, to Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="BH" />}}
A '''Weequay male''' served as a member of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]], led by fellow [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
The Weequay participated in an operation to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> trying to extort a portion of a highly valuable crop of [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] from a local [[Akira/Legends|farming community]]. When a scout sent to the village failed to report in, the Weequay reported his absence to Ohnaka.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
This pirate was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also voices [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars TV series'']].
